# تَدَافَقْتَ (tadāfaqta) /ta.daː.faq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَدَافَقَ (tadāfaqa)
# تَدَافَقْتِ (tadāfaqti) /ta.daː.faq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَدَافَقَ (tadāfaqa)
# تَدَافَقَتْ (tadāfaqat) /ta.daː.fa.qat/: third-person fem
